  Details:
  Full-chain SunMint E2E (email linking, sentinel rights, tree planting, growth monitoring, mark-invalid) on live beta + production, which surfaced and fixed 7 real production bugs and completed the email-sender cutover to admin@truesight.me.
  
  ## What was delivered
  
  1. **E2E verified end-to-end (real browser, live system):** email link (admin+sophia@truesight.me) → sentinel recognition (is_sentinel:true) → tree plant → monitor record → mark-invalid (sentinel gate proven; flow is share-by-hand by design, no ledger mutation).
  
  2. **7 production bugs found & fixed (all merged):**
     - sunmint_beta #28 — monitor offline queue corrupted photo Blobs (JSON.stringify(Blob)→{}) so records never POSTed; base64 dataURL fix
     - tokenomics #441 — missing processTreeGrowthMonitoringFromTelegramChatLogs webhook action in doGet
     - tokenomics #442 — handler returned undefined → TypeError in webhook; proper {processed,skipped,errors} return
     - tokenomics #446 — "DBH (cm)" label interpolated raw into RegExp → ( ) metacharacters broke match → monitoring records silently skipped; escapeRe() fix
     - tokenomics #447 — plain [TREE PLANTING EVENT] had no webhook action; added processTreePlantingTelegramLogs
     - dao_protocol #149 — ROUTING had no [TREE PLANTING EVENT] entry; added dispatch so plantings auto-fire the webhook
     - tokenomics #448 — .claspignore must ignore Credentials.js (clasp push had deleted the live secret file twice — 2026-08-19 and again 2026-08-29); restored seeding-only Credentials.js via Apps Script API + deployed @7
  
  3. **Email-sender cutover:** verification emails now send From admin@truesight.me (was garyjob@agroverse.shop) — deployed mailer as admin@ (clasp credential swap), new deployment @32, webhook repointed, live-verified through a real registration.
  
  4. **UX fixes (earlier in the campaign):** sunmint_beta #22/#23 (linked-email state + unlink button deleting both keys, both pages), #25 (restore index.html emptied by an edit-anchor failure).
  
  5. **Infra wiring:** set DAO_PROTOCOL_WEBHOOK_TREE_PLANTING_PROCESSING + TREE_GROWTH_MONITORING env keys on the dao_protocol box (verified in running process), restarted service; tree index rebuilt (18→19 trees).
  
  6. **Documentation:** agentic_ai_context #840 — SUNMINT_E2E_RUNBOOK.md (pipeline map, E2E procedure, key identifiers, 7 incident traps, §5g cleanup pattern).
  
  7. **§5g discipline:** test identity row deleted via write-capable SA; all 3 synthetic E2E test photos removed from sunmint/images/ (404 verified); ledger rows from real signed test submissions kept (legitimate proof records, no monetary value).
  
  ## Verified end state (production data)
  - 3 E2E plantings in SunMint Tree Planting tab (rows 24-26), contributor Sophia Truesight, matched by signature
  - Monitoring record in Tree Growth Measurements (DBH 12.5, photos, Sophia Truesight)
  - Tree index: 19 trees including Edgar_20260829134707_005
  - Auto-dispatch live: env keys loaded in running pid, dispatch_event wired (routes/dao.py:501)
  - Webhooks: @7 (planting) and @36 (monitoring) verified {"status":"success"}
